# spo_theme (Resource)

Manages a SharePoint tenant theme (Add/Get/Set/Remove-SPOTheme, CSOM), keyed by the theme name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "spo_theme" "contoso" {
  identity = "Contoso"
  theme_json = jsonencode({
    palette = {
      themePrimary   = "#0078d4"
      themeSecondary = "#106ebe"
    }
  })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `identity` (String) Name (Identity) of the object; also the create key. Changing it forces replacement.
- `theme_json` (String) The theme palette as a JSON string (e.g. {"palette":{"themePrimary":"#0078d4"}}).

### Optional

- `is_inverted` (Boolean) Whether the theme is a dark (inverted) theme.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
